name: Tofail Ahmed
contribution: Tofail Ahmed was a student leader and Awami League organiser who became a prominent figure in Bangladesh’s mass movements and party politics.
context: His public career connected the 1969 uprising, the Liberation War generation, and later anti-authoritarian mobilisation.
impact: He represents the bridge between street organisation and the institutional politics of post-independence Bangladesh.
seoDescription: Profile of Tofail Ahmed, tracing links to the 1990 Mass Uprising, anti-Ershad movement, and democratic transition in Bangladesh.
